summary:
Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the repo; nothing was run, so test outcomes are unverified.

Changes:
- rich/progress.py: TimeElapsedColumn (between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn); Task.finished_time field (after _get_time, before visible); Task.finished is now "finished_time is not None"; Task._reset clears finished_time; Progress.update and Progress.advance capture elapsed as the last step inside the lock when completed >= total and no finished time is present; Progress.reset clears finished_time before refresh.
- rich/default_styles.py: "progress.elapsed" -> yellow.
- rich/palette.py: Palette.__rich__ returns a Table (Index/RGB/Color, title "Palette", caption "N colors" right-justified, highlight on); imports inside the method and TYPE_CHECKING-only Table import.
- CHANGELOG.md: Unreleased / Added entry naming Progress.TimeElapsedColumn.
- tests/test_palette.py (new): test_rich_cast.
- tests/test_progress.py: new test_time_elapsed_column; TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns after TimeRemainingColumn; expected output updated by hand from a clock-read trace (start frame shows 0:00:37/0:00:36 with 25-wide bars; final frames show frozen 0:01:00/0:00:45 with 16-wide bars and speed 1 byte/s). Regex checks confirmed the bar widths and 12 elapsed cells.

Not done: no tests were run (per instructions), so the test_columns expectation and the new tests are unverified. tests/test_columns.py (the Columns test) was not changed; the spec's test_columns was interpreted as the progress test. No commits made.
